description: Campaign level 29 is completable: the opponent bot for the player walks a warden along the old causeway at the first low tide, raises a Boathouse (which wakes the marsh stones), takes stones on two isles past the boat people's landings and holds them for three minutes, then crosses the risen dry road and sandbar and burns both rival Boathouses while the rival still stands (bot wins near tick 23000; stages at about 1500, 6750 and 20500).
